title: ResourceAllocationResult
description: Deterministic serializable snapshot of resource allocation among organism demands

initial_resource.description: Total resource quantity available before allocation

total_requested.description: Sum of all requested resource amounts

total_allocated.description: Sum of all resource amounts successfully allocated

remaining_resource.description: Resource quantity remaining after all demands are processed

allocations.description: Individual allocation records strictly sorted by organism_id ascending

organism_id.description: Unique identifier of the demanding organism

unmet_amount.description: Deficit between requested and allocated amounts
